description: This file contains unit tests for the RoleValidator class in the OpenMRS project. It verifies the validation logic for Role objects, including checks for null/empty role names, leading/trailing spaces, and field length constraints.

classes.name: RoleValidatorTest
classes.description: A test class for validating the RoleValidator's behavior on Role objects.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRoleIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the role name is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when the description is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRoleHasLeadingOrTrailingSpace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the role name contains leading or trailing spaces, and checks for specific error codes.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes when role and description are properly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when role and description fields have acceptable lengths.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if role and description exceed maximum length constraints.
